title: Kuro's four expression portraits and Mio's annoyed face
question: Which face should Kuro use for flirtatious, teasing, pleased and polite, and is one of Mio's annoyed faces good enough (one each)?

media.caption: Why: on Showcase register-reactions-1 you wrote that Rei's reaction line was "lacking emotion in the dialogue picture" because she only had a neutral; rei-expressions-1 fixed that, and Kuro has the same gap (only kuro-neutral). Faces from her voice sheet: flirtatious smile, teasing, pleased (flattered by a compliment), cool front-desk politeness. Mio already has deadpan, smile and embarrassed (flustered), so only "mildly annoyed" was missing from hers. Same method as Rei: only the face repainted (below the fringe to the chin, inside the jaw line) on each neutral's own render; hair, outfit, framing and cut-out are the neutral's pixels, and the glasses frame is pasted back unchanged. Fangs in the negative. All 57 attempts in order, faces only, each neutral first, with dashboard numbers; rejected ones are marked. Round 1 (#1394-#1408, denoise 0.7): Kuro's lips came out glossy navy-purple and her eyes wide and round instead of heavy-lidded; Mio got a second lens rim drawn inside her frame. Round 2 (#1415-#1429): only denoise down to 0.55; same faults. Round 3 (#1436-#1450): back at 0.7, one change each: Kuro gets "wide eyes, round eyes, glossy lips, shiny lips, purple lips" in the negative (lips then came out brown or dark teal), Mio's kept frame grown 6 px (rim gone). Round 4, Kuro only, no new render: the round-3 lips recoloured to her neutral's near-black, brightness kept (the -lip files).
All 57 as game files (the same size, scale and matte as kuro-neutral.webp and mio-neutral.webp), each neutral first.

Image check, Kuro: every file fails red rim at 9.3%, exactly the installed kuro-neutral's number (the outline is untouched neutral pixels); face drift ccip 0.012 to 0.033, all pass. No glasses reference exists for her; the frame is the neutral's own pixels.
Image check, Mio: all 9 pass (red rim 0.0%, glasses cover 1.00, ccip 0.003 to 0.006). The check does not see the inner lens rim of rounds 1 and 2; that was judged by eye.
